rubric.role_summary: Electrical engineer owning an LFP battery pack and battery management system for a power-storage product, from cell selection and design through integration, testing, and safety protection.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Electrical engineer owning an LFP battery pack and battery management system for a power-storage product, from cell selection and design through integration, testing, and safety protection.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Experience with large-format or stationary storage, EV packs, or microgrids.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Familiarity with UN 38.3, UL 1973 or UL 9540, or maritime battery standards.
- A background in cell sourcing and vendor qualification.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): Greater Austin, TX area. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Onsite work is based in one of these areas.
